hero.title: Services
hero.positioning: I design and engineer the parts of a product that have to hold up under real traffic — custom WordPress plugins, production React interfaces, the integrations between them, and the performance work that keeps it all fast. Senior execution, one accountable engineer, no hand-offs.

engagements.name: Plugin Build
engagements.description: A custom WordPress or WooCommerce plugin designed around your workflow — architected for performance, secured by default, and documented so your team can own it.
engagements.closing: A plugin that feels native to your stack, not bolted on.

engagements.name: Frontend Build
engagements.description: Designs translated into a production-ready React or Next.js interface — component system first, screens second, with accessibility and Core Web Vitals treated as requirements.
engagements.closing: Built for scale, not for demos.

engagements.name: Integrate & Optimize
engagements.description: For products that already exist: connect the tools your business runs on and remove what's slowing the site down — audited, measured, and fixed.
engagements.closing: Faster pages and fewer manual steps, measured.

expect: Direct access to the engineer building your product
Weekly progress updates with working previews
Accessibility and performance built in from day one
avoid: Scope that grows without a conversation
Black-box code only one person understands
Plugins stacked on plugins to patch a problem

scope.caveat: Fixed quote after a short brief · No hourly surprises

good: You need a custom WordPress plugin or a serious extension to one
You have designs and need them built properly in React / Next.js
Your site is slow and it's costing you conversions
You value clean code that outlives the project
notFit: You need a cheap template install or theme tweak
You want the fastest possible delivery at any quality
There's no clear owner on your side to make decisions
The project is a large team-scale build with no room for senior focus

steps.title: Send a brief
steps.text: A short form about your goals, budget and timeline.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.text: 30 minutes to confirm fit and sharpen the scope.

steps.title: Fixed proposal
steps.text: A clear plan, timeline and quote within 48 hours.
